replicate_statements: Mean±s.d. of three independent experiments is reported.
outputs.explanation: The cell-death quantification bar graph in panel A is explicitly reported as mean±s.d. of three independent experiments, giving both the n-number (3) and the replicate type (independent experiments).

Panel B presents a quantitative bar chart of cell death (%) with visible error bars, but the legend text for panel B gives no number of replicates or replicate type; no n-number or replicate type can be found anywhere in the caption for this panel.

outputs.explanation: The legend states that the cell-death time-course data in panel C are mean±s.d. of three experiments, providing both the replicate number (3) and type (independent experiments).

Panel D shows a quantitative bar chart of cell death with error bars, implying replicated measurements, but the caption ('analysed 40 h after transfection for cell death and protein expression') does not state how many replicates were performed or what kind (e.g., independent experiments).
